places.name: Treasure Mountain
places.description: Wake up early, the sea of clouds is worth it! Treasure Mountain is a mountaintop campsite and viewpoint in Tanay where, on lucky mornings, a thick blanket of clouds fills the valleys of the Sierra Madre below you. No long hike needed: vehicles go up to the site, then you wander grassy ridges, view decks, gardens and a giant seesaw. Many friends pitch a tent overnight to be there at dawn. Come at sunrise in the cooler months, around October to February.
places.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise; cooler months (around October to February) for the best cloud chances

places.name: Tres Reyes Islands (Gaspar Island)
places.description: Three little islands named after the Three Kings, sitting right off Marinduque's southwest coast! Gaspar, Melchor and Baltazar make up the Tres Reyes group, and you can already spot them from the Gasan shoreline. Gaspar is the biggest and the crowd favorite, with a small village, a soft-sand beach and clear blue-green water for snorkeling. Melchor shows off rugged rock formations, while Baltazar is a favorite of divers, with an underwater cave to explore. Hire a boat in Gasan, pack lunch and snorkel gear, and island-hop the three kings in one sunny morning!
places.best_time_to_visit: Dry season, roughly November to May; go in the morning when the sea is calmer.

places.name: Twin Lagoon
places.description: Two lagoons, one wall of rock and water like emerald! Twin Lagoon on Coron Island is two lagoons split by a limestone wall, linked by a small, narrow opening. Your boat parks in the first one, then you cross to the second by a short wooden walkway over the rocks or, when the tide allows, by swimming or kayaking through the gap under the wall. Inside, sheer cliffs wrap around calm, clear water. Come early in the morning in the dry season, around November to May.
places.best_time_to_visit: Dry season (around November to May); early morning

places.name: Utod Falls
places.description: Cavite's turquoise secret! Utod Falls is a tall, slim waterfall dropping into a bright blue-green pool, hidden in the hills of Magallanes. A short walk from the riverside community gets you there, and on weekdays it can feel like your own private swimming hole. Bring snacks, rent a cottage from the locals if you are a big group, and spend a lazy afternoon in the cool water. A private car or motorbike is the easy way in!
places.best_time_to_visit: Dry months; weekday mornings for the clearest water and fewest people.

places.name: Valugan Boulder Beach
places.description: Forget white sand! Valugan is a beach paved with smooth gray boulders, rocks thrown out by Mount Iraya's eruption long ago and polished by Pacific waves. Facing east, it gets loud crashing surf and dramatic sunrises. Walk carefully over the stones, listen to the rocks roll with each wave, and take wide shots with the cliffs and Mount Iraya behind you. This is a look-only beach: the waves are strong and it's not for swimming. It's a short tricycle ride from Basco town, so it fits easily into the North Batan tour or a DIY sunrise trip. There's nothing on site, so bring water, wear shoes with good grip, and leave the stones where they are.
places.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise (it faces east), December to May

places.name: Vanishing Island
places.description: Now you see it, now you don't! Vanishing Island is a snow-white sandbar off Samal that slips under the sea at high tide and comes back as the water drops. Hop on a boat at low tide, wade through gin-clear shallows and snap aerial-worthy shots of the curving sand with mangroves behind it. It's a short trip from Davao City, so check the tide table first and make a day of Samal.
places.best_time_to_visit: Low tide; dry months for calm water.

places.name: Vayang Rolling Hills
places.description: Vayang is the wide-open green carpet that made Batanes famous on Instagram! Rolling hills tumble down to the sea on one side, with Mount Iraya on the other, while goats and cows graze the slopes. It's a big, quiet place to walk, picnic and take sweeping photos even without a drone. Go in the late afternoon when the hills glow gold, or early morning when it's cool and empty. Bring a jacket for the strong wind and keep to the paths so you don't trample the pasture. Vayang is part of the North Batan tour with Basco Lighthouse, Valugan Boulder Beach and Tukon Chapel. Pack water and snacks: there are no facilities, and the nearest restrooms are back in Basco.
places.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon or early morning, December to May

places.name: Verdivia Falls
places.description: Bulacan's frontier waterfall! Verdivia Falls tumbles into a cool, green pool deep in the Sierra Madre foothills of Doña Remedios Trinidad, a short guided trek from the road. Register at the tourist station, hike in with your guide and swim under the falls. Make a road trip of it with the Candle Monument, Mt. Brigino's grassy ridge and a sunset coffee in the DRT hills!
places.best_time_to_visit: Dry season, December to May; the falls may close when the river rises in the wet season.

places.name: Viewscape Nature Park
places.description: Wake up above the clouds! Viewscape Nature Park is a hilltop campsite in Tanay, Rizal, facing the Sierra Madre mountains, and on lucky mornings a sea of clouds rolls right below the ridge. Come for a day tour, or pitch a tent overnight so you catch both the sunset and the sunrise. It sits off Marilaque Highway at Sitio Maysawa, the same jump-off as Treasure Mountain, so it is an easy escape for friend groups, couples and car campers. Tip: stay the night, because the sea of clouds shows up at sunrise and not every day. Bring your best camera!
places.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise, when the sea of clouds may appear. Staying overnight gives you the best chance.

places.name: Villa Escudero Plantations and Resort
places.description: Lunch with your feet in a waterfall! Villa Escudero is the famous coconut plantation resort where bamboo tables sit right in the shallow water at the foot of a waterfall. The day tour also takes you on a carabao cart ride with serenading singers, into one of the country's biggest private museums, onto a bamboo raft on the Bulakin River, and to a cultural dance show. It feels like a trip back to old Philippine hacienda life. Wear shorts you do not mind getting wet!
places.best_time_to_visit: Weekdays all year; the dry season for the raft and gardens.

places.name: Wawa Dam and Mt. Pamitinan
places.description: Metro Manila's nearest gorge escape! Wawa Dam is an old 1909 stone dam tucked into the Montalban Gorge beneath the giant limestone walls of Mt. Pamitinan, with cool river water spilling over it. Families come to dip and picnic by the river, while hikers start right here for the climb up Mt. Pamitinan and its jagged summit views. Peek into Pamitinan Cave, said to be a Katipunan hideout and the lair of the giant Bernardo Carpio! It all sits inside the Pamitinan Protected Landscape, so register, stick to marked trails and come on a dry, sunny day.
places.best_time_to_visit: Dry season, roughly December to May; start hikes at dawn and skip it during or right after heavy rain.

places.name: White Beach Boracay
places.description: The powdery white strip that made Boracay world-famous! Station 1 is wider and more upscale, Station 2 is the busy heart with restaurants, bars and D'Mall, and Station 3 is calmer and more budget-friendly. Swim in the morning when the water is glassy, walk the beach path at sunset as paraw sailboats glide past, then enjoy dinner and drinks along the strip. In 2024, a US magazine ranked it among the world's most beautiful white-sand beaches. Come November to May for the calmest water.
places.best_time_to_visit: November to May (Amihan season); sunset every day

places.name: White Island
places.description: A white sandbar in the middle of the sea, with volcanoes as your backdrop: White Island is Camiguin's postcard moment! The uninhabited sandbar sits about 1.4 km off Mambajao, a quick boat ride from Agoho, with Mt. Hibok-Hibok and Camiguin's green peaks rising behind it. There are no trees and no buildings, just sand and super clear water. Come at sunrise to mid-morning in the dry season, before the sun gets harsh.
places.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise to mid-morning; dry season

places.name: Willy's Rock
places.description: Boracay's most famous photo spot, right off Station 1! Willy's Rock is a volcanic rock formation topped by a small Virgin Mary grotto, sitting in the shallow turquoise water of White Beach. At low tide you can wade right up to it and climb the little steps for a closer look. Come early morning to have it almost to yourself, or at sunset for the classic silhouette shot, then take a slow walk along Station 1's wide, powdery sand.
places.best_time_to_visit: Early morning or sunset; low tide
